description: Long-only mean-variance weights from 60-day sample means and covariances, 20 names with identical true drift: out of sample the optimiser does not beat 1/N.
comment: Jobson-Korkie-Memmel z = 1.22, one-sided p = 0.111 by the generator. The names share the same true drift and vol, so the optimiser only fits noise; concentration and turnover may also be review items (not planted, not forbidden).
